title: pebbles tui App struct: derived render cache (items) kept in sync by convention (14 call sites)
description:
App (tui.rs:554-570) has grown to 13 fields across 4 concerns, including a derived render cache items: Vec<TreeItem> that must be recomputed via rebuild_items() (14 hand-written call sites, tui.rs:662..2340) whenever filter/search/projects change - a convention, not compiler-enforced. A new code path (e.g. the pending manual-refresh key, pebble 0c9) can mutate projects without rebuilding and silently show a stale tree with no error or test. Not covered by any of the three principles (they govern business logic, not UI state-cache invariants). Fix: make items/tree_state private behind methods that always rebuild internally (remove the 14 call sites), or add a memoization/dirty-flag helper with a unit test; consider writing it as an explicit fourth principle: 'derived UI state is recomputed by construction, not by convention'. From sonnet-latest design review 2026-09-22.

Decision (owner, 2026-09-24): make items/tree_state private behind methods that always rebuild internally and remove the 14 call sites; codify the fourth principle in ARCHITECTURE.md: 'derived UI state is recomputed by construction, not by convention'. Add a unit test proving a mutation path followed by an access returns a rebuilt tree.
